blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.
blocks.zh: 工业异常探测(IAD)是查明和确定偏离正常产品条件的地方性任务,对于制造业自动化质量检查至关重要。 IDD的许多视觉语言模型依靠大型域特有数据集进行微调并单行道进行预测,因此没有机会重新审查模棱两可的区域. 虽然工具使用剂可以再去这些区域,但预先定义的工具界面限制了它们如何在后续检查中结合中间结果. 当这种检查不够时,模型可能会漏掉微妙的缺陷或误认出缺陷类型. 为解决这一限制,我们引入了ADClaw,一个使用可执行代码来测试异常假说而不进行特定任务微调的检查代理. 对于每个假说,一个结构常态(Structured Normality Preference)确定适用的规则并检索检查目标的正常视觉参考. 在此之前的指引下,代理在持续检查工作台上写出并执行代码,将口罩,异常图,以及从早期步骤的测量结果结合到对疑似缺陷的新测试. 每次检查后,"假设证据"(Hypothesis-Guided Effairs Reasoning)评估证据是否支持被怀疑的缺陷及其位置,利用证据中的漏洞或不一致来指导下个代码动作. ADClaw在2D和3D工业异常检测基准的检测和本地化以及MMAD的异常理解方面都取得了竞争结果.

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) aims to identify and localize deviations from normal product conditions and is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing [ 2 , 33 ] . A defect may occupy only a small fraction of an image [ 4 ] , and changes in illumination can make a normal surface appear anomalous [ 47 , 20 ] . Detecting a deformation can require a geometric measurement, while identifying a misplaced component requires examining its relationship to the rest of the assembly [ 48 , 5 , 18 , 56 ] . Consequently, a region that looks unusual in isolation may be normal for that part, and an intact part can still be in the wrong place. Reliable diagnosis requires identifying which property to examine, where and at what scale to measure it, and what constitutes a normal value or arrangement for the product.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测(IAD)旨在识别并定位偏离正常产品条件的情况,对制造业自动化质量检查至关重要[2,33]. 缺陷可能只占据图像[4]的一小部分,而光照的变化可以使正常表面显得异常[47,20]. 检测变形可能需要几何测量,而识别出错的元件则需要检查其与其他组装[48,5,18,56]的关系. 因此,孤立地看似不同寻常的区域可能对该部分来说是正常的,完整无缺的部分仍然可能在错误的地方。 可靠的诊断要求确定哪些财产需要检查,在何地和在何种规模上加以衡量,以及什么构成产品的正常价值或安排。

blocks.en: This distinction between locating a deviation and interpreting it is reflected in the evolution of IAD benchmarks. MVTec AD and VisA pair image-level labels with pixel-level defect masks, while MVTec 3D-AD and Real3D-AD extend localization to 3D scans [ 3 , 63 , 6 , 31 ] . More recent benchmarks ask what the localized evidence means [ 15 ] . VisA-D&R asks models to describe defects and suggest possible causes, and MMAD includes questions on defect type, location, and analysis among the seven tasks it evaluates [ 50 , 23 ] . Through image–text supervision, vision-language models (VLMs) can connect visual features to defect descriptions [ 41 , 25 ] and incorporate observations from specialist detectors to identify anomalies [ 17 , 28 ] . Datasets such as MMR-AD further provide reasoning annotations to support domain-specific training for anomaly understanding [ 52 ] . Many methods adapt VLMs through supervised fine-tuning, sometimes combined with reinforcement learning [ 50 , 10 , 27 ] , yet precise localization remains challenging [ 58 ] . In single-pass inference, a model that encounters an ambiguous region must answer from its initial observation, with no opportunity to inspect it more closely or compare it with the corresponding part in a normal sample of the same product at a comparable scale.
blocks.zh: 发现偏差与解释偏差之间的这种区别反映在内部审计司基准的演变中。 MVTec AD和VisA配对图像级别标签并带有像素级别缺陷口罩,而MVTec 3D-AD和Real3D-AD则将本地化扩展到了3D扫描[3,63,6,31]. 较近期的基准询问本地化证据的含义[15]. VisA- D( D) R要求模型描述缺陷并提出可能的原因,MMAD在其评价的七项任务中包含关于缺陷类型、位置和分析的问题[50,23]。 通过图像-文本监督,视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以将视觉特征与缺陷描述相连接 [41,25],并吸收从专家探测器的观测结果来识别异常[17,28]. MMR-AD等数据集还提供推理说明,支持针对特定域的培训以了解异常[52]. 许多方法通过有监督的微调来适应VLM,有时结合强化学习[50,10,27],然而精确的本地化仍然具有挑战性[58]. 在单通推论中,一个遇到模棱两可的区域的模型必须从其最初的观察中回答,没有机会更仔细地检查,也没有机会以可比较的尺度将它与同一产品的正常样本中的相应部分进行比较.

blocks.en: To revisit uncertain predictions, tool-using inspection agents can zoom in on a region [ 49 ] , retrieve normal examples, or consult product knowledge [ 35 , 59 , 57 ] . They can also test candidate defects against normal references over several rounds and revise a judgment as evidence accumulates [ 24 ] . With a predefined tool interface, however, the agent can request only the operations that the interface exposes. Testing a hypothesis may require new computations on the outputs of earlier tool calls. If a diagnosis requires combining a part mask with an earlier anomaly map and measuring how far that part deviates from a matched normal reference, selecting the next tool may leave the relevant property unmeasured. An untested hypothesis can lead to a missed defect, as Figure 1 illustrates, or to an incorrect diagnosis of its type. How, then, can an inspection agent use what it has already observed to construct the next check needed to test a specific anomaly hypothesis?
blocks.zh: 为了重新审视不确定的预测,使用工具的检查剂可以放大到一个区域[49],检索出正常的例子,或者查阅产品知识[35、59、57]。 他们还可以在几轮中对照正常的参照标准测试候选缺陷,并随着证据的积累而修改判决[24]. 然而,通过预先定义的工具界面,代理机只能请求接口所暴露的操作. 测试一个假说可能需要对先前工具调用的产出进行新的计算. 如果诊断需要将部分口罩与更早的异常地图合并,并测量该部分偏离匹配的正常参照度多远,则选择下一个工具可能会使相关地物得不到测量. 如图1所示,未经测试的假说可能导致缺失缺陷,或对其类型的诊断不正确。 那么,检查机构如何利用它已经观察到的情况来构建测试具体异常假说所需的下一个检查?

blocks.en: We approach this problem by letting the agent express each inspection action as executable code. Given a suspected defect, the agent writes a check that combines perception tools with computations on their earlier outputs. The execution result supplies a new observation and determines what remains to be checked. A product-specific normality rule or a matching normal reference gives the measurement its diagnostic meaning. This makes it possible to revise either the measurement or the hypothesis when an observation is inconclusive or conflicts with a measurement from an earlier step. We implement this approach in ADClaw , an industrial inspection agent that keeps its pretrained models fixed and constructs these checks at inference time for the product and region under inspection.
blocks.zh: 我们通过让特工以可执行的代码表达每次检查行动来解决这个问题。 鉴于疑似有缺陷,代理商会写出一张检查表,将感知工具与对其早期输出的计算结合起来. 执行结果提供了新的观察,并确定了有待检查的内容。 产品特定常态规则或相匹配的常态参考赋予了测量其诊断意义. 这使得在一项观测结果无结论或与早先步骤的测量相冲突时,可以修改测量或假设。 我们在ADClaw这个工业检查代理机构实施这一办法,该代理机构对经过预先训练的模型进行固定,并在推断时为被检查的产品和区域构建这些检查。

blocks.en: ADClaw begins each check with a Structured Normality Prior that links objects and parts to applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references at the relevant scale. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench . The workbench retains masks, anomaly maps, and measurements together with their inspection targets, spatial extent, and sources. A later action can restrict a full-image response to a newly identified part in 2D or use a geometric measurement to select a complementary view of the same 3D scan. After execution, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning checks that the observations required by the hypothesis are present and assesses agreement among the applicable scores, locations, and defect labels. Missing or conflicting evidence guides the next code action. When inspection ends, the agent fixes its decision and localization before generating an explanation. Our contributions are as follows. • We cast each inspection step as a code action that tests a suspected defect. The agent uses the result of one check to design the next, reusing earlier measurements to refine its diagnosis without task-specific fine-tuning. • The Structured Normality Prior links a part to its rules. The Inspection Workbench runs the check and saves its results. Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning tests if they support the suspected defect or warrant a new check. • ADClaw achieves competitive results on 2D and 3D defect detection and localization. On MMAD, it also improves on adaptive tool calling in identifying a defect’s type and location with the same backbone and tools.

blocks.en: Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding. Many industrial detectors learn what an intact product looks like from normal samples [ 54 , 19 , 12 ] . They localize deviations by comparing a test patch with stored normal features [ 42 , 11 ] or by measuring disagreement between teacher and student representations [ 13 , 46 , 43 ] . A misplaced part can nevertheless match a normal patch. To detect such violations, component-level approaches measure part properties and model their relationships [ 5 , 32 , 18 ] . For an assembly, this can mean checking whether all required parts are present and whether each occupies an allowed position [ 5 , 56 ] . In 3D inspection, signals from shape and appearance provide complementary evidence [ 48 , 7 ] . Recent benchmarks also ask models to classify localized defects and explain their visible characteristics [ 23 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测与理解. 许多工业探测器从正常的样品中了解到完好无损的产品是什么样子 [54, 19, 12]. 它们通过比较一个与所储存的正常特征[42,11]的测试补丁,或者通过衡量师生代表的分歧[13,46,43],将偏差本地化. 错误的部分仍然可以匹配普通的补丁 。 为了发现这种侵权行为,组成部分一级的方法衡量部分属性并模拟其关系[5、32、18]。 对于一个组装来说,这可以指检查所有所需部件是否都存在,以及每个部件是否占据一个允许的位置[5,56]. 在3D检查中,从形状和外观发出的信号提供了补充证据[48,7]. 最近的基准还要求模型对局部缺陷进行分类并解释其可见特征[23,50].

blocks.en: VLM-Based Industrial Anomaly Detection. Vision-language models use text to specify what a detector should look for [ 41 ] . Comparing local image features with prompts describing normal and anomalous states enables zero-shot localization [ 22 , 61 , 8 , 39 , 34 ] . Generative models extend this comparison to defect description through image–text supervision, visual expert features, and instruction tuning [ 17 , 28 , 50 , 29 ] . One way to train a model to describe a local defect is to pair a simulated anomaly with text that specifies what changed and where [ 17 ] . Supervised reasoning traces and reinforcement learning further adapt these models to industrial questions [ 27 , 52 ] . Fine-grained localization nevertheless remains challenging after in-domain training [ 58 ] . A single-pass prediction also gives the model no opportunity to request a new measurement to distinguish a subtle defect from normal variation in the surface appearance of an intact part under varying lighting conditions.
blocks.zh: VLM-基于工业异常检测. 视觉-语言模型使用文本来指定一个探测器应该寻找什么[41]. 将本地图像特征与描述正常和异常状态的提示进行对比,可以实现零发本地化[22、61、8、39、34]。 基因模型通过图像-文本监督、视觉专家特征和指令调制[17、28、50、29]将这种比较扩大到缺陷描述。 训练一种模型来描述局部缺陷的一种方法是将模拟异常物与文本相配,其中具体说明了变化之处和地点[17]. 监督推理痕迹和强化学习进一步使这些模型适应工业问题[27,52]. 然而,经过国内培训后,精细的本地化仍然具有挑战性。 单行道预测也使模型没有机会要求新的测量,以区别一个完好无损的部位在不同的照明条件下表面外观的一丝微妙的缺陷和正常的变异.

blocks.en: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Detection. Inspection agents can revisit uncertain regions by cropping or enhancing an image, comparing parts, and retrieving normal examples [ 35 , 45 , 59 ] . Policies trained on tool feedback can weigh the diagnostic value of another call against its cost [ 45 ] . Other agents explicitly try to refute each suspected anomaly against normal references and update their verdict after each tool call [ 24 ] . These agents can choose a new tool as evidence changes [ 51 ] , but a predefined interface constrains which measurements they can request. Local cropping helps examine suspicious regions, but quantifying their deviation from normality requires measurements within the target region and comparison with matched normal references. ADClaw lets the agent write a follow-up check that operates directly on earlier masks, maps, and measurements. A check measures part-level deviations against matched normal references and preserves each measurement and its source region for later checks.
blocks.zh: 代理工业异常检测. 检查人员可以通过裁剪或增强图像、比较部件和检索正常实例[35、45、59],重新审视不确定区域。 接受工具反馈培训的政策可以权衡另一个呼吁的诊断价值与成本[45]。 其他特工则明确试图反驳每个被怀疑的异常现象与正常的引用,并在每个工具调用后更新其判断. [24]. 这些代理可以选择一个新工具作为证据变化 [51],但预定义的界面会约束他们可以要求的测量. 当地作物种植有助于检查可疑区域,但要量化它们偏离正常程度的情况,需要在目标区域内进行测量,并与相应的正常参考进行比较。 ADClaw允许代理人撰写一个后续检查,直接操作在更早的口罩,地图和测量上. 对照对应的正常参考文献进行部分水平偏差的检查测量,保留每个测量及其源区域,以便日后进行检查.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a product image or 3D scan x x of category c c , ADClaw tests anomaly hypotheses through executable code (Figure 2 ). The Structured Normality Prior (SNP) supplies rules and normal references for the suspected deviation. Guided by this prior, the planner writes actions in the persistent Inspection Workbench (IW), combining tool calls with computations on retained outputs. Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning (HER) checks whether the results support the defect and its location, and directs further inspection when evidence is incomplete or inconsistent. Models remain frozen, with normal references supporting comparison and calibration.

blocks.en: SNP organizes normality knowledge through an object–part hierarchy linked to multi-scale visual memory. The ontology 𝒪 c \mathcal{O}_{c} specifies observable part attributes, inter-part relations, and grounding prompts. Normality rules ℛ c \mathcal{R}_{c} associate the corresponding constraints with inspection targets, required observations, and tool operations. Tool contracts 𝒯 \mathcal{T} define inputs, outputs, and applicability. Semantic information is manually organized and reviewed to provide explicit inspection targets and criteria.
blocks.zh: SNP通过一个对象–与多尺度视觉内存相链接的部分层次来组织常态知识. 肿瘤 O c\ mathcal{O}_{c} 指定可观察到的部分属性, 段间关系, 和起落提示 。 正常性规则 R c\ mathcal{R}_{c} 将相应的约束与检查目标,所需的观察,和工具操作联系起来. 工具合同 T\ mathcal{ T} 定义输入、 输出和适用性 。 对语义信息进行人工组织和审查,以提供明确的检查目标和标准。

blocks.en: 4.1 2D Industrial Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 4.1 2D 工业异常检测

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows consistent image-level benefits across
2D inspection scenarios: ADClaw leads on seven of eight
image-level metrics, with its largest I-AUROC gains over the Qwen baseline
occurring on MVTec LOCO AD and GoodsAD. This pattern is consistent with
the value of normality-grounded inspection for compositional constraints
and product-specific appearance variations. Normal references, object–part
semantics, and explicit rules jointly contextualize the visual discrepancies
observed during inspection. On MVTec LOCO AD, ADClaw combines the highest image-level AUROC and F1-max with the second-best pixel-level AUROC, supporting effective anomaly discrimination alongside spatially informative inspection. These results support combining visual comparison with structured inspection using frozen pretrained models.

blocks.en: 4.2 3D Industrial Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 4.2 三维工业异常检测

blocks.en: Table 2 reports ADClaw’s 3D detection and localization on Real3D-AD and MVTec 3D-AD. ADClaw achieves the highest object-level AUROC and average precision on both benchmarks and ranks second on all reported localization metrics, indicating a strong balance between anomaly discrimination and local defect localization. Registration residuals and normal-feature comparisons provide complementary numerical evidence, while programmable inspection links these measurements to specific inspection targets for further hypothesis-specific verification.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了ADClaw在Real3D-AD和MVTec 3D-AD上的3D检测和本地化. ADClaw实现了最高的物体级AUROC,在两个基准上的平均精确度,在所有所报告的本地化指标上排名第二,表明异常歧视和本地缺陷本地化之间有很强的平衡. 登记残留物和正常情况比较提供了补充数字证据,而可编程的检查将这些测量与具体的检查目标相挂钩,以便进一步根据具体假设进行核实。

blocks.en: 4.3 Anomaly Understanding
blocks.zh: 4.3 异常理解

blocks.en: Table 3 demonstrates ADClaw’s broad capabilities in anomaly understanding on MMAD. ADClaw achieves the highest average accuracy and ranks among the top two on all seven tasks, leading in anomaly discrimination, defect localization, defect description, defect analysis, and object analysis. Compared with the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone, the gains are particularly pronounced in defect classification and localization, suggesting that hypothesis-specific checks help connect visual deviations to concrete defect types and spatial locations. Normal references provide a basis for judging deviations, while programmable inspection supplies targeted observations, together supporting anomaly understanding from recognition to defect description and analysis.
blocks.zh: 表3显示了ADClaw在对MMAD的异常理解方面的广泛能力。 ADClaw在所有7个任务中都实现了最高的平均准确度并排在前两位,导致异常歧视,缺陷本地化,缺陷描述,缺陷分析和对象分析. 与同名的Quen3.5-9B骨干相比,这些收益在缺陷分类和本地化方面尤为显著,表明假说特定检查有助于将视觉偏差与混凝土缺陷类型和空间位置联系起来. 通常的参考文献为判断偏差提供了依据,而可编程检查用品则有针对性地观察,同时支持从识别到缺陷描述和分析的异常理解。

blocks.en: Figure 3 traces how executable checks revise an initial missing-screw hypothesis. The agent combines a retained full-image anomaly response with part masks to examine the suspected components, then checks composition and component integrity. Evidence that all expected components are present rejects the initial hypothesis, while the washer’s localized response and shape comparison support a broken-washer diagnosis. The trace illustrates how the workbench reuses intermediate results and HER directs a subsequent check toward the unresolved defect before the final answer is produced.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 evaluates the Structured Normality Prior (SNP), the Inspection Workbench (IW), and Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning (HER). Removing SNP lowers Defect accuracy from 79.21% to 75.85%, supporting the role of normality priors in defect understanding. Removing IW reduces it to 76.65%, consistent with the value of reusable evidence. Removing HER yields the largest Anomaly drop, from 74.98% to 70.80%. Object accuracy varies less across variants.
blocks.zh: 表4评估了结构正常性(SNP)、检查工作台(IW)和假设-指导证据理由(HER)。 移除 SNP 将精度从79.21%降低到75.85%,支持常态前行在理解缺陷中的作用. 删除 IW 将其降低到76.65%,与可重复使用的证据值一致. 清除她后,异常下降幅度最大,从74.98%降至70.80%。 不同变体的物体精度差异较小.

blocks.en: Table 5 compares inspection strategies with the same backbone, tools, normal references, preprocessing, and evaluation. Fixed Tool Pipeline executes a predefined sequence. Adaptive Tool Calling selects tools from earlier observations, treating their outputs as transient feedback. ADClaw retains structured evidence for reuse, hypothesis revision, and consistency validation. Adaptive selection increases the overall mean from 78.73% to 80.32%, and ADClaw raises it to 82.11%. Relative to adaptive calling, ADClaw gains 2.58, 2.06, and 0.85 percentage points on Anomaly, Defect, and Object, respectively, illustrating the value of evidence organization for defect-oriented inspection.
blocks.zh: 表5将检查战略与同样的主干、工具、正常参考、预处理和评价进行比较。 固定工具管道执行预定义的序列. 适应工具呼叫从早期观测中选择工具,将其输出作为瞬间反馈. ADClaw保留了用于再利用、假设修订和一致性验证的结构化证据。 适应性选择将总平均率从78.73%提高到80.32%,ADClaw将其提高到82.11%。 相对于适应性要求,ADClaw在Anomaly、Defect和Object上分别获得了2.58分、2.06分和0.85分,说明了证据组织对以缺陷为导向的检查的价值。

blocks.en:
Table 6 examines inspection strategies with
the same visual tools and available evidence. Adding predefined tool compositions to adaptive calling
improves detection while reducing visual-tool calls, suggesting that organizing
inspection operations contributes beyond adaptive tool selection.
Programmable inspection further improves performance at a nearly identical
call count, with larger gains on logical than structural anomalies. This
pattern is consistent with the value of flexible composition for checking
relationships and constraints that individual tool outputs may not fully
capture. Overall, ADClaw improves I-AUROC over adaptive tool calling by
3.19 percentage points while using fewer visual-tool calls.

blocks.en:
Table 7 compares view-selection strategies
under matched view budgets. Coverage is computed over the unique input-scan points jointly visible across the selected views; defect coverage applies the same calculation to annotated defect points. Uniform-angle sampling uses evenly spaced viewing directions; surface-coverage-first selection prioritizes additional visible surface, while geometry-guided selection targets suspected anomalous regions. Geometry-guided selection consistently achieves
the highest defect coverage, with its largest advantage under the two-view
budget, exceeding surface-coverage-first selection by 8.90 percentage points.
This suggests that geometric guidance is particularly useful when only a few
views are available. At six views, geometry-guided selection maintains broad input-scan surface coverage while providing greater defect visibility than surface-coverage-first selection. This pattern supports allocating views to geometrically suspicious regions in addition to expanding overall surface coverage. These results demonstrate that geometry-guided selection improves defect visibility within a limited view budget.

blocks.en:
Table 8 compares the computational costs of different inspection strategies and budgets on 2,000 images sampled from MMAD. A workflow is considered complete when it executes successfully and produces a final report. Completion rates are averaged across repeated runs, while latency, executed steps, and planning-token consumption are averaged over all attempts. Fixed Plan follows a fixed initial plan, whereas Adaptive selects tools based on observation feedback. All ADClaw variants retain HER for evidence reasoning. Selective further uses the evidence state to determine whether additional inspection is needed, with the same 12-step limit as ADClaw (12). Within ADClaw, increasing the budget allows
more inspection and verification, improving workflow completion at the cost of
higher latency and planning-token consumption. This motivates adapting inspection
depth to the evidence requirements of each workflow. HER-guided selective continuation uses evidence readiness and completeness to decide whether to continue inspection. It prompts further verification when evidence is insufficient and ends inspection once the decision requirements are satisfied.
Compared with the 12-step configuration, it reduces mean latency by 12.2% while
achieving a workflow completion rate of 94.00%, together with lower planning-token
consumption and fewer executed steps. These results illustrate how HER coordinates inspection depth with evidence needs, enabling ADClaw to maintain a high completion rate while controlling average inference cost by avoiding unnecessary follow-up verification.

We measure evidence reuse through paired, fixed-trace replay on 1,000 MVTec LOCO

and subsequent postprocessing. All 1,000 paired runs pass output-equivalence

The workbench reduces repeated visual computation while preserving
evidence for subsequent inspection.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented ADClaw as an evidence-grounded framework for industrial anomaly detection and reasoning that writes and executes code to combine perception tools with prior observations into checks of anomaly hypotheses, and evaluated it across 2D, 3D, and anomaly-understanding benchmarks. The results show that programmable inspection and intermediate evidence validation can improve defect-oriented reasoning while maintaining competitive detection and localization performance, and that retaining and reusing inspection results can reduce redundant visual computation during multi-step inspection. By combining code-driven inspection with the retention and reuse of intermediate results, ADClaw offers an effective approach to tool-augmented industrial inspection and multi-stage diagnostic reasoning, particularly when diagnosis requires combining local measurements and checking part relationships and normality constraints. Future work will improve local defect inspection, cross-modal consistency, and generalization to unseen industrial categories and inspection settings.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ADClaw作为工业异常检测和推理的循证框架,它写出和执行了将感知工具与先前的观察结合起来的代码,以检查异常假说,并用2D,3D和异常理解的基准来评价它. 结果显示,可编程检查和中间证据验证可以在保持竞争性检测和本地化性能的同时改进面向缺陷的推理,保留并再利用检查结果可以减少多步骤检查过程中的冗余视觉计算. 通过将代码驱动的检查与中间结果的保留和再利用相结合,ADClaw为工具强化的工业检查和多阶段诊断推理提供了一个有效的方法,特别是在诊断需要结合当地测量和检查部分关系和正常性限制时. 今后的工作将改进地方缺陷检查、跨模式一致性和向看不见的工业类别和检查环境的概括。
